entry_execution: five-minute post-only LIMIT at the frozen short-horizon boundary with contingent TP/SL

development_week.use: inventory/depth family development only; not counted as a fresh random-week pass

feature_causality.direct_features: completed one-minute aggTrades, bookDepth and price bars
feature_causality.oi_features: original five-minute OI bar timestamp plus five minutes, then backward as-of joined to direct minutes
feature_causality.future_labels: not copied into the merged feature matrix
feature_causality.adaptive_thresholds: all use shift(1) before rolling quantiles

causal_question: When aggressive flow reaches a short-horizon external boundary, is rising OI plus front-depth withdrawal creating accepted new-inventory price discovery, or is falling OI revealing forced liquidation that exhausts after depth recovery and a range reclaim?

mutually_exclusive_states.setup: aligned three-minute aggressive flow and return, above-threshold turnover, OI increase, efficient impact, front-depth withdrawal and a close outside the frozen boundary
mutually_exclusive_states.confirmation: a completed one-minute outside hold with non-opposing flow
mutually_exclusive_states.entry: post-only limit at the accepted boundary

mutually_exclusive_states.setup: aligned three-minute aggressive flow and return, above-threshold turnover, OI decline, toxic flow and an external boundary sweep
mutually_exclusive_states.confirmation: completed close back inside after front-depth recovery and directional flow failure
mutually_exclusive_states.entry: post-only limit at the consumed boundary
mutually_exclusive_states.invalidation: beyond the event extreme plus 0.10 ATR

event_count_diagnostic_before_performanc.scope: event definitions only; no orders, fills, PnL or NAV

family_promotion_rule: The central 15-minute boundary and at least one adjacent 10- or 20-minute boundary must satisfy every gate. Only then is the unchanged 15-minute classifier locked before a newly selected uncollected first BTC week.
fresh_data_rule: No fresh random-week data is collected before the revealed-week horizon plateau passes.
